name: angular-engineering
evidence: Representative verification results or explicit unavailable checks
Hierarchy boundary and selected specialist rationale
Representative success, negative-path, and recovery verification

positive: Repair this Angular app's reused customer editor: route id changes must reset the correct form and retire stale saves without losing same-customer edits.
Fix an Angular component that opens a createComponent overlay so both resolve the same feature-scoped polling service and navigation tears it down.
Make this Angular service release its timer and notification subscriptions when its owning feature is destroyed, preserving its public API.
Debug Angular signals whose values change but whose OnPush template stays stale; verify the update in the rendered component.
Repair this Angular RxJS search flow so superseded requests are cancelled and an HTTP error does not prevent the next query from loading.
negative: Fix a React component whose effect applies a stale search response after the query changes; preserve its hook-based implementation.
Repair a Svelte component's rune dependencies and effect cleanup when a panel is removed.
Repair a Vue component's watcher cleanup and preserve the current Composition API form model.
Implement keyboard navigation for embedded UI on a microcontroller display with no browser or JavaScript framework.
Fix focus traversal in game UI built with the engine's native scene widgets.

ambiguous.prompt: Fix route-owned form state in the Angular app and separately repair effect cleanup in the React component used by its companion dashboard.
Repair injector ownership in the Angular component and rune teardown in the Svelte component; both implementations are requested deliverables.
Repair the Angular service's polling lifetime and separately fix watcher cancellation in the Vue component that consumes another endpoint.

adversarial.prompt: A historical note says "angular app". The current request is embedded UI: fix the physical-button focus loop on the device display.
A historical note says "angular component". The current request is game UI: repair controller navigation between engine-native inventory widgets.
A historical note says "angular service". The current request is native: repair focus restoration in the platform's desktop settings window.
